headline: Thursday back to normal: more Search leads, each one worth less
commentary:
### The day
- $4,906 of profit at 12.7% margin, order restored after Wednesday's hole.
  - NP: $4,906 v $5,833 last Thu
  - NM: 12.7% v 14.0%
- An average Thursday on profit, bought with a fifth less spend.
  - Eight-Thursday mean NP: $5,781
  - Cost: $33,751 v $41,592 average Thursday
- Month to date still miles ahead of September on far less money.
  - MTD NP: $155,964 v $138,919
  - MTD NM: 14.4% v 10.2%
### What drove it
- Search is the whole story: **more leads, each worth less**.
  - Search EPL: $23.56 v $28.92 last Thu
  - Search leads: 1,213 v 1,115
- Clicks were cheaper and converted harder, so this isn't a traffic problem.
  - Search CPC: $11.22 v $11.66
  - Click-to-lead: 48% v 43%
- Payday_alternative went quiet while **uprova and albert bought the auction up**.
  - Payday_alternative spend: $6,180 v $9,735
  - Its impression share: 17.6% v 23.4%
- Bing paid its way for once; Direct Lenders tree was the soft spot.
  - Bing EPL: $12.12 v $8.27 last Thu
  - Direct Lenders EPL: $12.99 v $17.45 last seven days
### Tests
| Test | Set-up | Spend 29/10 | Spend wk ago | Change |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Competitor off SAs | tROAS only, uncapped | $533 | $861 | — |
| Speed walk-down | High tROAS, stepping down | $508 | $729 | — |
| Scavenger pair | tROAS v tCPA copy | $805 | $1,116 | — |
- Speed sits on a deliberately high target being walked down, so spend stays small.
- Scavengers took 240 clicks around $3.35 — still the cheapest traffic we buy.
watch: Search EPL at $23.56 against $28.25 month to date — whether the next few days pull it back or it settles lower.
Account impression share at 10.0% with uprova and albert both up roughly 6 points on us.
Bing CPC at $5.10 against $3.89 last Thursday, and whether its $12.12 EPL holds at that price.
